cards.title: Jensen Huang to Testify Before Senate on Nvidia Scandal
cards.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces scheduled Senate testimony following his reinstatement, amid bipartisan calls for questioning about alleged affairs including one with a suspected Chinese spy. The public hearing marks ongoing scrutiny of Huang's return to leadership.

cards.title: Amazon Acquires Decart's AI Optimization for $7.5B
cards.body: Amazon is acquiring Decart's AI optimization technology and research team in a $7.5 billion deal to strengthen its AI capabilities. The move positions Amazon to advance Trainium chip sales and AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Trump Advocated for Jensen Huang's Return to Nvidia
cards.body: President Trump told CNBC he called Nvidia's board to convince them to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. The administration's intervention marks significant political backing for the embattled executive.

cards.title: Trump Endorses Huang Return, Cites No US Evidence
cards.body: Trump defended Huang's reinstatement by stating the U.S. attorney general found no wrongdoing while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation. The endorsement signals White House support for the Nvidia CEO.

cards.title: Sierra Doubles Valuation to $30B in Series F
cards.body: AI customer experience platform Sierra, co-founded by ex-Salesforce CEO Bret Taylor, raised $1.75 billion in Series F funding. The valuation jump reflects surging enterprise demand for AI in customer service.

cards.title: Nvidia Reverses Course, Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
cards.body: Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as CEO in a stunning reversal backed by senior U.S. government officials. The decision ends his brief absence following personal scandal revelations.

cards.title: Major Investors Bet Billions on Anthropic Pre-IPO
cards.body: Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford shared their conviction for backing Anthropic before its public offering. The three significant backers collectively wagered billions on the AI company's potential.

cards.title: OpenAI Scientist Proposes Speed Limit for AI Development
cards.body: OpenAI's chief scientist outlined strategies to establish speed limits on AI advancement through standardized measurement frameworks. The proposal aims to create consensus on measuring AI development pace.

cards.title: Signal Restricts Screenshots Over AI Surveillance Threat
cards.body: Signal limited screenshot capabilities in both Android and iOS apps to counter 'existential threat' of AI-powered surveillance. The privacy-focused platform is adapting to emerging security concerns.

cards.title: Top AI Text Message Agents for Work and Lifestyle
cards.body: A curated list highlights leading AI agents living in text messaging apps across general assistance, family, travel, and work categories. These agents bring AI capabilities directly to everyday messaging platforms.

cards.title: AI Face Licensing Trend Raises Hollywood Ethics Questions
cards.body: An actor licensed his AI-generated face to a microdrama startup in a practice already popular in China. Industry experts warn of potential long-term consequences if the trend spreads to Hollywood.

cards.title: Daniel Ek Backs AI Researcher's Fusion Power Startup
cards.body: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is investing in Europa Fusion, a fusion power company founded by an AI researcher. The startup aims to advance clean energy through advanced research.

cards.title: AI and Human Solutions for 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis
cards.body: AI delivered a breakthrough solution to the Riemann hypothesis while a competing human solution emerged simultaneously. Mathematicians are amazed by both AI-driven and human-created advances on the century-old problem.

cards.title: Lenders Hesitant to Finance Space Data Center Chips
cards.body: Financial institutions resist backing collateral sent to orbit via SpaceX due to space environment risks. The lending gap raises questions about financing viability for space-based data centers.

cards.title: Nvidia Reports Strong Growth Amid Huang Scandal Fallout
cards.body: Nvidia delivered solid earnings despite CEO Jensen Huang scandal while halting H200 chip sales to China. The company promised continued growth despite leadership turbulence and export restrictions.

cards.title: Apple Reportedly Developing AI Agent for Mac
cards.body: Apple appears to be building AI agents to compete with Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude, and OpenAI Dots. The iPhone maker is expanding its AI capabilities beyond consumer devices.

cards.title: Philosopher Challenges Anthropic's Consciousness Claims
cards.body: A renowned philosopher disputes Anthropic's assertion that AI could be conscious or sentient. The company flagged consciousness risk in its pre-public investment disclosures.

cards.title: AI's Judgment Problem Gets Major Update
cards.body: METR's new report shows some AI capabilities continue improving exponentially, but models struggle with judgment-based tasks compared to coding. The findings update previous AI capability assessments.

cards.title: AI Hype Index: AI Spreads Everywhere
cards.body: AI integration is becoming ubiquitous, from Google's AI Overviews to humanoid robots. The phenomenon reflects both innovation and market saturation across tech.

cards.title: Startup Claims AI Nose Matches Human Smell
cards.body: New Jersey researchers developed AI technology to identify and catalog odors at human-level accuracy. The breakthrough could revolutionize scent detection applications.

cards.title: Asus ProArt P16 Showcases Local AI Future
cards.body: The Asus ProArt P16 laptop demonstrates emerging local AI capabilities without cloud dependency. The device signals a shift toward on-device AI processing.

cards.title: Google Search Gets AI Chat History Feature
cards.body: Google's redesigned search homepage integrates AI chat capabilities with search history. The update removes the traditional search button in favor of AI-first design.

cards.title: Meta Reconsiders Climate Goals Amid AI Emissions
cards.body: Meta's 2030 net-zero commitment faces pressure as AI data centers drive record emissions. The company grapples with sustainability challenges from its AI infrastructure expansion.

cards.title: Researcher Exposes AI Supply Chain Privacy Flaw
cards.body: A researcher planted 2 million canaries into AI systems and uncovered major privacy vulnerabilities. The discovery reveals critical gaps in AI model security and data handling.
